answer: Divergent-Challenge Identity Ladder. Each identity must periodically answer a fresh random challenge drawn from a private seed; clones sharing one seed answer identically, revealing collusion. Answers are scored against a per-identity history weighted like basalt—dense, slow to shift—so copied responses lag. Honest agents diverge freely, like willow bending to new input. A clone must purchase a separate seed and rebuild history from quartz-hard scratch, paying full onboarding compute per identity.
